sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F7]There is a place [Bb]where Jesus sheds The oil [Eb/Bb]of gladness [Dm/F]on [Eb]our heads,
[Bb]A place than all [Eb/Bb]besides [Bb]more sweet; It is the blood-bought [F]mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F7]There is a scene [Bb]where spirits blend, Where friend [Eb/Bb]holds fellowship with friend;
[Bb]Though sundered far, [Eb/Bb]by faith they [Bb]meet Around one common [F]mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F7]There, there, on angel's [Bb]wings we soar, And earthly [Eb/Bb]cares [Dm/F]molest [Eb]no more,
[Bb]And heaven comes [Eb/Bb]down our souls [Bb]to greet, And glory crowns the [F]mercy seat.

sections.name: Verse 5
lines: [F7]Ah! whither should [Bb]we flee for aid, When tempted, [Eb/Bb]desolate dismayed?
[Bb]Or how the hosts [Eb/Bb]of sin defeat, [Bb]Had suffering saints no [F]mercy seat?
